$doc: What each Claude surface can do for a requirement the analyzer finds. Read by scripts/analyze.mjs to fill requires[].surfaces and the schedule thresholds.
Surfaces: cloudTask, localTask, artifact. A value is ok, needs:<thing> (works once <thing> is confirmed or set up) or no.
Every value carries a source. Phase 0 overwrites value and source with what it observed on a real account.

connectors.<name>.operations.<node type>.ops: per n8n operation (resource:operation, or poll for the trigger; tool variants <type>Tool use their base type), the connector tool that does it and how sure that is: confirmed is tool-exists (the tool's schema was seen on a real account, not yet run), no-tool (no tool of the connector can do it), not-captured (connector not attached where the schemas were taken) or observed (ran on a real account). An unlisted operation gives needs:connector-operation-check. A no-tool operation falls back to the app's own REST API with a stored secret: the surfaces of requirements.connector-api, and the report lists it in noTool.
substitutions: blocked nodes with an approvable replacement. The outcome stays subscription; the report adds a substitution requirement and blocker.
nodeRequirements: node types that add a requirement of their own, beyond their kind.

httpSubstitutions: optional replacements found by http-hosts.json rules. model: an HTTP call to an LLM API runs as a Claude model step on the subscription instead of with an API key. It adds a substitution requirement, no blocker: keeping the call with its key also works.
